svg.title: Update your notes before saving
svg.desc: The production NoteChangesModal asks about an Idea callout renamed to Insight whose test ID was removed, with illustrative note counts from synthetic data. Each change has its own part with the answers preselected on opening; nothing is saved and no note is edited.
